extracted text: The base metal (BM) was a 7.5-mm-thick 2219-T6 aluminum alloy plate. The grain structures of the BM show white precipitates, which are identified as the Al Cu intermetallics from the energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS) analysis. The plate-shaped precipitates in the BM are found to be h' phases according to the electron diffraction patterns. The size of the precipitates distributed in the BM is 54 ± 24 nm in diameter and 4 ± 1.8 nm in thickness.
